name: v-text-chunk1225
note: Text line breaking, broken-line queries, and the generic UI font switch from v_text.cpp (1-316).
auditSeams: A single-character color code is not consumed, so the break gives it glyph width, while StringWidth of the stored line skips that same byte. A bracket color is consumed and adds no glyph width. The word-break pointer stays on the first byte of a whitespace run, so a later newline in that run splits there and the following skip eats the newline. A newline clears the carried color unless preservecolor is set. A hard break walks back over UTF-8 continuation bytes. The first glyph is kept even when it is wider than the line. Kerning is added after a glyph is kept and is not part of the overflow test. An out-of-range string query returns a one-byte 0xFF string because the -1 converts through FString(char). UpdateGenericUI uses strtoll base 0, falls the big font back to NewSmallFont, and rewrites only the i and I case-map slots when REQUIRED_CHARACTERS contains U+0130.
auditRationale: UNCredited v_text.cpp 1-316 (+316). The file ends at 316. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.
auditUncreditedRangeCheck: uncredited_range_check.py --file src/common/fonts/v_text.cpp --start 1 --end 316 and a full tally line scan → no overlap.
